units: <cite ref="Shabbat 74a:1">Sabb. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>עני … בלא כ׳</he> a poor man eats his bread without pounding the grain before grinding (to remove the husks), v. <cite ref="K01391"><he>כָּתַשׁ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Beitzah 7b:24">Bets. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>והא קא עביד כ׳</he> but (by crushing the clods of earth) does he not do the (forbidden) act of pounding? <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:3:2">Cant. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>מה השמן … אלא ע״י כ׳ וכ׳</he> as the oil cannot be improved except by pounding (the olives), so can Israel only by suffering; <cite ref="Menachot 53b">Men. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>מה זית</he> … <he>ע״י כ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="K01365"><he>כתית</he></cite>, corr. acc.) as the olive gives forth its oil only through pounding &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 289:1">Yalk. Jer. 289</cite>.
